title: wevm/mppx mppx@0.20.0
quote: Added mppx/extensions/identity/erc8004: an ERC-8004 agent identity provider. The client prover signs each request with the agent's wallet, and the server's verifier and payment check require that the wallet the Identity Registry names (on Tempo mainnet by default) signed the request or signed the transaction or proof of a tempo charge.

title: wevm/mppx mppx@0.20.1
quote: Added x402 sign-in-with-x support: evm.charge({ x402: { siwx } }) lets a wallet that signs the 402's challenge get the resource without paying when grant approves it, and Siwx.wrapFetch answers that challenge on the client before mppx pays.
